title: Oracle at Delphi as a burning methane seep

tellings.quote: oracle at Deli was a methane seep, a burning methane seep.

plain: The oracle at Delphi, the place in ancient Greece where a priestess gave prophecies, was really "a burning methane seep," a spot where natural gas leaked out of the ground and burned. That is the view of a researcher named Geoffrey Drumm, who states it to Michels in passing without naming a source. If true, the famous holy site would have been built around a natural gas vent.
